criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence conclusively excludes the predicted pathway or its claimed degradation. Beneficial synthetic-data training in another system does not by itself falsify this open-ended product-specific forecast.

evidence.explanation: Ai2 describes training on trajectories generated by GPT-5 using its own tools and prompts. This is relevant synthetic-data training, but does not establish ingestion of OpenAI Deep Research output or resulting collapse.

The experiments distinguish replacing original data from accumulating synthetic data alongside it. This challenges an automatic inference from synthetic-data ingestion to collapse, but predates and does not test OpenAI Deep Research.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: An inspectable training dataset or disclosure identifying Deep Research outputs, paired with controlled evaluations establishing their effect on later-model degradation.
